scope: Initial independent complete-plate review, followed only by checks of repaired support and coverage.
primary_assessment: Accepted the independent evidence and verdict for a complete experimental part trial.

findings.summary: The two early bracket feet have measured native backing at a 0.2 mm gap.
Actual support is absent from the rod bore and both clip mouths.
Actual support is absent from both hinge operating spaces and full pivot bores.

independent_hinge_placement_witness.source: One independent batched probe of both G-code archives

physical_trial_limits: Bought DFR0030 dimensions and pin/hole placement still need fitting.
Support cleanup, hinge sag, arm/clip strength, rod grip and click feel remain unverified.
